provenance.extraction: Retain original protocol, all complete outer ledger records, all 20 episodes and all 184 actual delivery observations; remove repeated native request/response payloads and unrelated capture/tool/source snapshots. Every retained value is unchanged. Original failed analysis row retained.

preparation_native_calls.scope: candidate preparation native differential calls only; not VM or SMT evaluations

protocol.acceptance: All registered outputs/counts/releases/source/tool checks must pass. Cold measured candidate opportunity requires complete fixed-policy standalone cost below the fresh baseline-only control. Native NDU incremental observed net value requires its complete attributed cost below fixed, feedback-greedy and light-DP, with and without the recorded native build allocation. Finite wall differences are descriptive and do not establish statistical or algorithmic superiority.
protocol.candidate_bank: Fresh full-component C capture, independently proved direct-call closure/first-trap bridge, original all-input scalar TV, selected LLVM check, actual compiler and 64-case native differential for every image. The fixed arm receives the combined 8/10 guard and complete generic fallback, as do all other arms.
protocol.cost_scope: Actual preparation, complete source capture/bridge proofs, all candidate TV/LLVM/native checks, compile/seal, calibration, common input/reference-cache construction, lookup/holding/cleanup, trace writes, fresh-child startup/loading/guards/execution/output validation, controller startup/evaluation/shutdown, source/tool rechecks and failures. Common measured costs are charged once per standalone policy. Baseline-only control pays its own fresh one-image bank and reference preparation, not unused candidate search. Native NDU's already measured original build allocation is reported separately and added to the build-inclusive total; it is not called a new cold-machine build. Post-policy same-model audit and aggregate encoding are separately retained, not inserted into live policy costs.
protocol.feedback_control: Choose the lowest estimated complete current-request cost using the common calibration and this episode's completed observations only.
protocol.fixed_control: Before delivery, choose and commit the complete trace's per-divisor static dispatch table from the common calibration bank, including the combined guard candidate. No subsequent policy computation or feedback changes it.
protocol.information: Same public inputs, divisors, full registered trace, admitted bank, calibration and reference-cache contract. During delivery each adaptive arm sees only its own completed observations. Future validation timings and other arms' outcomes never enter a decision.
protocol.input_gate: Each complete vector has at least 4000 distinct values and at least 1500 values on each side of the signed bit boundary; all five vectors are distinct.
protocol.input_generation: SHAKE256(domain + /training/-1 or /validation/group), 4096 little-endian u32 inputs; first eight overwritten by the fixed numerical boundary vector. Inputs, repetitions, divisor and ordering are identical across all arms.
protocol.native_controller: The actual pinned original Rust stream bridge recursively evaluates all at most 64 supplied candidate paths and its literal abstention. No simulated NDU, hidden lookahead, host answer repair or NDU result cache. Exact same-model DP audit follows all policy execution and is excluded from policy ranking but included in total study cost.
protocol.planning_control: Exact bounded dynamic programming for the next at most three registered requests, with the same estimates, horizon and remaining wall budget as native NDU. Only the first action is executed before replanning.
protocol.registration: locally committed and frozen before first economic-study run; no public preregistration claim
protocol.schedule: Four cyclic Latin policy orders. A mandatory fresh baseline-only bank control runs before the four policies in even groups and after them in odd groups. Calibration rotates four candidates by repetition and divisor index. No sample exclusion or retry.
protocol.source_C_domain: Original C has undefined denominator-zero and INT_MIN/-1 cases; HIA's defined first-trap comparison covers those bit patterns separately. The application workload uses positive denominators 8,10,13 and full signed numerator bits.
unknown_or_excluded_costs: outer process startup/imports and final aggregate encoding are measured by the external process receipt, not silently zero
no energy or dedicated-host statistical qualification
